## Context

basicly-gates run 46030924364 attempt 1 (pin PR #58, a marketplace.json-only commit) failed in the job mods on newest Claude Code: the scripts test sends no key after the prompt when the wait for the end of the turn passes its limit (live.test.mjs, 996 ms) failed; attempt 2 of the same commit passed. A timing test that fails on one run of an unchanged commit.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run the job mods on newest Claude Code of basicly-gates on any commit; attempt 1 of run 46030924364 failed, attempt 2 passed.

## Confirmation Plan

Read the test and its time limit; make the wait deterministic with the fake clock or a wider limit with a reason; CI green on three runs.
